purpose: Transparent, provisional prior for demonstrating how crop sequence could affect soil organic-carbon condition in Markov and Monte Carlo simulations.

soil_proxy.property: SoilGrids organic carbon, depth-weighted mean of 0-5, 5-15 and 15-30 cm layers
limitations: SoilGrids is a mapped mean prediction at a municipal-centroid grid cell, not a field soil test.
Organic carbon alone does not describe soil fertility, structure, compaction, erosion, or crop suitability.
Class thresholds are selected for this demonstration and are not calibrated for Brazilian soils or crop response.

rotation_groups.legume: Leguminosas: soybean, peanut and dry bean.
rotation_groups.grass: Gramíneas: maize, sorghum and grass intercrops.
rotation_groups.perennial: Perennials and semi-perennials; excluded from the annual rotation demonstration.

transition_hypotheses.edge_rule: A decrease/increase moves one class only; a move beyond low/high is folded into the boundary class.

directional_reference.document: Cultivo do Milho: manejo de solos, rotação de culturas
directional_reference.supports: The source describes the soil-cover role of crop residue, notes soybean generally leaves less residue than maize, and recommends diversified rotations that maintain residue cover.
directional_reference.does_not_support: The numerical Markov transition probabilities in this file.
